name: tree-projector-ad
description: MORZ, Christmas Tree Projection Light: 15 s 9:16 ad for TikTok, Reels and Facebook Reels (Remotion + procedural sound).

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/projector-silent.mp4 -i public/projector.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart -shortest tree_projector_ad.mp4
scripts.build: npm run sfx && npm run render && npm run mux
